name: My Safety Plan
intro: You will fill in a short example plan with gentle, made-up answers (a walk, a coffee shop, a call to “my sister Ann”), save it, change one line, and check it is still there after a reload. Please don’t tap any “Call” or “Talk to someone now” button in this test — they really dial.

steps.do: When the app opens, a dark card says “Welcome — this is your pocket safety plan.” Tap “Start with warning signs →”.
steps.see: A page titled “Build your plan” opens, starting with “Step 1 — My warning signs” and an empty box.
steps.tip: The light-blue “🤍 Talk to someone now” bar stays at the bottom of every page. Don’t tap it in this test.

steps.do: Without typing anything, scroll all the way down and tap “Save my plan”.
steps.see: A short note says “Saved — it's yours” and you are back on the “Welcome.” page with a “Build my plan (10 minutes)” button — nothing was filled in.
The “Build your plan” page opens again with empty boxes.

steps.do: In Step 1, tap the box (“a warning sign…”) and type the example below.
steps.see: Your words are in the Step 1 box.

steps.do: In Step 2 (“Things I can do on my own…”), tap the box and type the example below.
steps.see: “Take a walk” is in the Step 2 box.

steps.do: Under that box tap “+ add another”, then type the example below in the new box.
steps.type: Play my O'Brien family hymn playlist
steps.see: Step 2 now has two boxes: “Take a walk” and “Play my O'Brien family hymn playlist”.

steps.do: In Step 3 (“People and places…”), tap the box and type the example below.
steps.see: “Coffee shop on Main” is in the Step 3 box.

steps.do: In Step 4 (“People I can ask for help”), type “My sister Ann” in the name box and the example number below in the phone box.
steps.see: Step 4 shows My sister Ann and 555-0142. Step 5 below already has the 988 line filled in for you — leave it as it is.

steps.do: Skip Step 6. In the last box, under “Why — The one thing most worth living for”, type the example below.
steps.see: “My grandchildren” is in the last box.
A card says “Your plan is ready.” with kind words and a “Keep it close” button.

Your plan shows with “❤️ My grandchildren” at the top, then numbered sections: your warning sign, “Take a walk”, the hymn playlist, “Coffee shop on Main”, “My sister Ann” with a “Call” button (don’t tap it), and Step 6 says “nothing here yet”.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “Edit my plan”. In Step 2, tap the × beside “Play my O'Brien family hymn playlist”.
steps.see: That box disappears; Step 2 now has only “Take a walk”.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “Save my plan”.
steps.see: Your plan shows again without the hymn playlist line; “Take a walk” and “My sister Ann” are still there.

steps.do: Tap the “Right now” tab at the top.
steps.see: A calm page with “How are you, honestly?” and five faces, “Breathe with the circle”, and lower down your “Things that have helped before” and “People I can reach”.
A line appears: “Noted. Checking in is a strength.”

steps.do: Tap “Start 1 minute” under the circle, watch for a few seconds, then tap “Stop”.
steps.see: The circle says “breathe in” (and keeps guiding you) while the button reads “Stop”; after you tap Stop the button goes back to “Start 1 minute”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Your plan is still there: ❤️ My grandchildren, your warning sign, Take a walk, Coffee shop on Main and My sister Ann. A dark strip “Install on iPhone: tap the Share button…” appears near the bottom.
steps.tip: You can leave that dark strip alone — it doesn’t stop anything working. (Its × can be hidden behind the round “?” button.)

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Tap “Build / edit”, tap “+ add another” under Step 2, type the example below, tap “Save my plan”, then turn Airplane Mode off.
steps.see: Even with no internet, your plan now shows both “Take a walk” and “Listen to the radio” in section 2.
